question: Which acts of hostility and disobedience disqualify a person from receiving the teaching?
premises: Hostility toward the yoginīs is named.
Transgression of the guru’s command is named.
inference: One who is hostile to the yoginīs and disobeys the guru is unfit to receive the teaching.
plain_english: One who is hostile to the yoginīs and who transgresses the guru’s command is excluded.
